gloss: communication speed; data transfer rate; connection speed

definitions.gloss: communication speed; data transfer rate; connection speed
definitions.explanation: The rate at which data is transferred over a network connection, typically measured in bits per second. Commonly used when talking about internet and mobile connections.

examples.japanese: {通信速度|つうしんそくど}が{遅|おそ}い。
{契約|けいやく}した{通信速度|つうしんそくど}が{出|で}ていない。
examples.english: I'm not getting the connection speed I signed up for.

examples.japanese: {通信速度|つうしんそくど}は{利用|りよう}する{時間帯|じかんたい}や{場所|ばしょ}によって{大|おお}きく{変化|へんか}する。
examples.english: Connection speed varies greatly depending on the time of day and location of use.

notes:
Composed of {通信|つうしん} (communication, telecommunications) and {速度|そくど} (speed). A standard term in discussions of internet plans, mobile data, and network performance. Japanese mobile carriers advertise maximum {通信速度|つうしんそくど} in their plans, and the word frequently appears in customer support contexts when users complain about slow connections.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通信速度|つうしんそくど}が{速|はや}い/{遅|おそ}い: the connection speed is fast/slow
- {通信速度|つうしんそくど}を{測|はか}る: to measure the connection speed
- {通信速度|つうしんそくど}{制限|せいげん}: speed throttling, bandwidth limit
- {最大|さいだい}{通信速度|つうしんそくど}: maximum connection speed
- {通信速度|つうしんそくど}が{低下|ていか}する: the connection speed drops

RELATED WORDS:
- {回線速度|かいせんそくど}: line speed — similar, often used for wired connections
- {速度制限|そくどせいげん}: speed limit (often refers to mobile data throttling)
- {通信量|つうしんりょう}: data usage
- {通信|つうしん}: communication, telecommunications
- ギガ: "gig" — colloquial for gigabytes of mobile data allowance
